intro: Search & download from Direct Connect hubs via the AirDC++ Web API. Reaches material indexers/DDL sites don't.
hubsNote: Limit searches to specific comic hubs (comma-separated). Blank searches every hub AirDC++ is connected to.
watchNote: Hub bots (users) that announce new uploads with magnet links. Messages from these nicks — in main chat or PM — are scanned, and announced files matching a missing issue of a followed series download automatically by exact hash. Enable and schedule the check on the Jobs page ("Watch AirDC++ announcements").
downloadNote: AirDC++ downloads to the first path; this app imports (copies) from the second. Only differ if AirDC++ is on another machine — map its folder onto the path this app reads over the network. The AirDC++ copy is left in place so it keeps sharing.
searchNote: DC results arrive from peers over a few seconds; the search returns as soon as a confident match arrives, or when the wait cap is hit. A search that returns nothing by Give up if empty stops there — a shared file's peers reply within seconds, so continued silence means it isn't on DC (this is what keeps searches for rarely-shared issues from crawling). Searches run one at a time spaced by the cooldown — DC hubs rate-limit, so bulk downloads are throttled (slow but reliable) rather than failing. An empty search may be retried Retry empties times, but keep this at 1 (or 0): many hubs flag the same search repeated ~3 times as spam and then return nothing anyway.
stallNote: Give up on a download that makes no progress for this long — a bundle with no seeders (or one AirDC++ drops from its queue) can otherwise stall the queue slot forever.
